note: Strumming-first additions chosen from docs/STRUMALONG_SONG_RESEARCH.md (25 Oct 2026). Capo, setup and skill notes are authored suggestions; practice patterns come from the level defaults unless given. Not checked against the recordings beyond the automatic chart sanity check.

songs.title: Three Little Birds
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, D and E shapes.
songs.skill_focus: Three easy open chords (A, D, E) with long holds and a relaxed reggae pulse. The recording's guitar plays short chops on the off-beats; start with four steady downstrokes per bar and learn the changes first.

sources.title: Published arrangement tempo marking: Three Little Birds

chart_check.note: Chart A/D/E; capo 0 confirmed. Pulse ~74 BPM. Automatic sanity check against the well-known progression and published tempo; not a musical review.

songs.title: A Horse with No Name
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo. Two shapes: Em, then D6add9/F# (2 0 0 2 0 0: first-finger F# on the low E string, second finger on the G string).
songs.skill_focus: Two shapes alternating, one per bar: an easy first change in a steady folk strum. The recording is a strummed acoustic guitar with a relaxed pulse.

sources.title: Published arrangement tempo marking: A Horse with No Name

chart_check.note: Chart Em7/Em with a second chord named F#m7, Dmaj7/F# or D; displayed as the played D6add9/F# grip via a label alias. Pulse ~123 BPM. Automatic sanity check against the well-known progression and published tempo; not a musical review.

label_aliases.note: The song alternates Em with the two-finger D6add9/F# grip (200200); the automatic chart names that chord F#m7, Dmaj7/F# or D

songs.title: Sweet Caroline
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 2 suggested: the recording is in B major, and with the capo on the 2nd fret the open shapes are A, D and E.
songs.skill_focus: A steady chord-per-bar song in three open shapes with a slightly swung strum under horns. A short walkdown near the chorus passes through F#m and Bm shapes; these are optional and you can stay on E.

sources.title: Published arrangement tempo marking: Sweet Caroline

chart_check.note: Chart sounding B/E/F#; capo 2 gives A/D/E shapes. Pulse ~129 BPM. Automatic sanity check against the well-known progression and published tempo; not a musical review.

songs.title: Wagon Wheel
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 2 suggested: play G, D, Em and C shapes; they sound as A, E, F#m and D.
songs.skill_focus: A four-chord loop (G-D-Em-C shapes) at a brisk tempo; keep the strum light and steady and change on time.

sources.title: Wagon Wheel (Wikipedia)

chart_check.note: Chart sounding D/A/E/F#m; capo 2 gives C/G/D/Em shapes. Pulse ~144 BPM. Automatic sanity check against the well-known progression and published tempo; not a musical review.

songs.title: Sit Down
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 7 suggested: the recording is in E major with E, A and B, and the capo on the 7th fret turns them into open A, D and E shapes. Capo 2 with D, G and A shapes gives the same sounding chords.
songs.skill_focus: Three chords with a bouncy, swung strum. Keep the strum loose and in time, and change on the bar line.

sources.title: Published arrangement tempo marking: Sit Down

chart_check.note: Chart sounding E/A/B; capo 7 gives A/D/E shapes (capo 2 would give D/G/A). Pulse ~129 BPM. Automatic sanity check against the well-known progression and published tempo; not a musical review.

songs.title: Yellow
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 4 suggested: the recording is in B major, and with the capo on the 4th fret the open shapes are G, D, C and Em.
songs.skill_focus: Big open strummed chords, one per bar, at a slow-to-medium tempo. Let the strings ring and practise the G, D, C and Em changes.

sources.title: Published arrangement tempo marking: Yellow

chart_check.note: Chart sounding B/E/F#/G#m; capo 4 gives G/C/D/Em shapes. Pulse ~86 BPM. Automatic sanity check against the well-known progression and published tempo; not a musical review.

songs.skill_focus: Three chords, one per bar, under a driving strummed acoustic. Keep the strum steady and change on the bar line.

songs.skill_focus: D, G and A at a brisk pace with a driving down-up strum on a bright acoustic. Practise quick changes between neighbouring open shapes.

songs.skill_focus: Four open shapes changing every two beats in a relaxed folk strum. Harmonica breaks appear, but the strummed guitar is the main part. Practise small, quick changes.

songs.skill_focus: A four-chord loop under an island-style strum with muted chucks, so the rhythm is the skill. Learn the changes with steady downstrokes first, then add the muted chucks.
